_how: Prompt 68 (operator, 4 Nov 2026: "Also add the one in Vila do Conde"): the arrival only. Vila do Conde has no golden-sample folder yet (no OSRM drive times, no school or health rows): its card keeps today's tiles (the price, the straight-line distances) behind the one-line answers. 'arrive' is the line under the name, from the Metro do Porto timetable (facts.csv metro-b-vila-do-conde); 'more' is the card's last line (facts.csv vdc-aqueduct, Câmara Municipal de Vila do Conde, checked 2026-11-04); 'camera' is the arrival flight, [lon, lat, zoom, bearing, pitch], up the coast from the Ave estuary to Marble Terrace Vila do Conde in Portas Fronhas. Read by scripts/map-data/place_cards.py.
